title: Signal Processing Engineer (Radar)
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As a confirmed Radar Signal Processing Engineer on Harmattan AI's Radar team in Paris, you will own the signal processing algorithms behind our next-generation airborne radar payload. You will take full ownership of your workstream, from algorithmic research through embedded implementation and flight validation, working with high autonomy and minimal oversight. You will work closely with the EW and RF analytics teams to translate product-level requirements into deployed, mission-ready capabilities. Responsibilities Design and implement near-real-time algorithms for radar image formation, including inverse SAR (ISAR) processing of moving targets. Develop and refine detection and tracking algorithms (e.g., EKF/UKF-based approaches) for moving target indication on airborne radar data. Build jamming estimation capabilities, combining out-of-band spectral sniffing with in-band spatial covariance analysis, and the adaptive logic that drives radar behavior in response. Contribute radar-derived observables and algorithms that support navigation when GNSS is unavailable. Prototype and port algorithms onto the selected embedded computing platform, balancing algorithmic performance against real-time and resource constraints. Validate algorithms end-to-end through hardware-in-the-loop bench testing, anechoic chamber campaigns, and real flight conditions, iterating quickly on results. Work closely with the EW and RF analytics modules to align signal processing development with system-level requirements. Candidate Requirements 2 to 5 years of confirmed, hands-on experience in radar signal processing, gained in the defense or automotive radar industry preferably. Solid experience in Signal Processing on radar systems, either FMCW or pulsed, is required; exposure to moving target tracking, ECCM, radar-based navigation, or live/real-time processing is a strong plus. Strong theoretical foundations and genuine hands-on comfort with the underlying mathematics, not reliance on off-the-shelf tools or LLM-generated solutions. A quick thinker, comfortable taking full ownership of a technical scope end-to-end with minimal oversight. Comfortable working in a fast, iterative cycle: writing code, running hardware-in-the-loop tests, and pushing validated changes independently. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture. About Superhuman Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that makes AI work for everyone. Over 40 million people rely on it daily to get work done. A recognized leader in productivity tools, Superhuman is the maker of popular products including Docs, Fathom, Go, GPTZero, Grammarly, and Mail. We're looking for someone to help us on that journey, help us build out new agents across Grammarly and Superhuman Go, and really define what these modern interaction patterns will be. You'd be involved end to end, partnering closely with our engineering and product teams, from Kyiv to Silicon Valley. In This Role You Will: Design zero to one agents. New writing and communication agents, built as AI-first products. A lot of the job is inventing interaction patterns that don't exist yet rather than applying ones that do. Work with designers you'll learn from. The team spans San Francisco and Europe, with people who've come from some of the best product companies around. If you're looking for a design-focused environment with a lot of people to learn from, you'll get that here. Pioneer new AI design workflows. The way we design is changing underneath us. We often start in code, refine in Figma, and ship frontend changes back into the codebase. We're defining that way of working as we go, and we want people who are excited to help build something that lets designers make whatever they can imagine. Shape design strategy. Bring user insights, prototype ideas, and help build a longer-term view of where the Agents roadmap goes. Lead and mentor. Raise the standard through critique, feedback, and working closely with less experienced designers. Qualifications Proficiency in industry-standard tools such as Figma and Claude Design is expected. The following outlines the skills and experience that will set exceptional candidates apart for this role. Extensive experience designing complex, scalable software. The kind of tool people sit inside all day, so productivity tools, creative or CAD software, developer tools. Most of that depth lives on desktop, so mobile isn't a primary focus for this role. A genuine interest in AI technology, both conceptually and in practical workflows like reading, writing and translating, and you're already experimenting with AI-driven prototyping. You care about language and writing. Words are the product here, so we want someone who also thinks about how a sentence works, what makes writing sound like a person, and how tone shifts depending on who you're talking to, not just the interface around the words. Comfortable working with metrics and data-driven design decision-making. Bonus is having worked directly in code and shipped PRs to production. title: Senior Talent Partner (12 month FTC)
description: Senior Talent Partner 📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 4 days WFH) | 💰 £50,000 - £60,000 Street Group is scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan, and hiring is about to get harder: more senior roles, a higher bar, and a market where the best people don't apply; they get found and won. We need someone who owns how we hire, not just who we hire. We're looking for a TA Specialist with a truly commercial mindset: skilled at your craft, able to own searches end-to-end across every part of the organisation with full autonomy, and a trusted partner to the hiring managers you work with. Why this role exists now Our recruiting team is strong but stacked. We've recently raised investment and have ambitious goals to achieve, which means hiring across every part of the business at the same time. We need an experienced recruiter who can pick up roles anywhere in the organisation, switch between them easily, and partner with hiring managers without needing a steer, so the whole team can keep hiring quality people at pace. We're hiring this role initially on a 12 month FTC, but if our growth continues the way it's going (and we expect it will!), there's every chance it becomes a permanent position. The role You'll own searches end-to-end across the entire organisation, often running very different roles side by side. That means switching context quickly: getting up to speed on each team's goals, how its roles tie in to commercial goals and what good looks like for them. You'll work through ambiguity largely on your own, pulling in your manager only for the genuinely strategic or sensitive calls. Strong stakeholder partnering is at the heart of the role. You'll build trusted relationships with hiring managers across the business, handle competing demands between teams, and bring market and funnel insight into role and salary conversations, so hiring managers trust your evidence when you influence role definition, expectations and candidate decisions. Along the way, you'll keep improving how your own searches run: smoother pipelines with less drop-off of good candidates, better scorecards and smarter sourcing. Day to day, that looks like: Running a varied set of searches across the whole business end-to-end, from intake to offer. Partnering with hiring managers in every team: shaping briefs, setting expectations and balancing competing priorities. Running structured interviews to a high bar, making confident calls on borderline candidates, and coaching hiring managers through the process. Keeping candidates warm and informed through long, multi-stage processes, so no one ever goes dark. Using AI, approved templates and Ashby automations to keep routine work fast, so switching between roles doesn't slow you down. Building repeatable AI-assisted approaches (sourcing prompts, interview kits, funnel views) and sharing the useful ones with the team. Who we're looking for An experienced recruiter with deep, reliable expertise across the full recruitment lifecycle, and the curiosity to get up to speed quickly on any part of the business. Experience recruiting across a wide range of functions at once, and switching context between very different roles without losing pace or quality. Strong stakeholder partnering: you build trusted relationships with hiring managers, and have the credibility to influence and constructively challenge them with evidence, in writing and in the room, including pushing back on a brief without damaging the relationship. Confident, consistent judgement of candidates whilst operating at pace. If you've worked through a period of growth you will feel right at home here. An AI-native mindset: you don't just use AI tools, you re-engineer your own workflows with them, and you know where AI can be trusted and where judgement needs to take over. title: Editor, International
description: Substack is building a new economic engine for culture, giving the brightest, most interesting, and most creative people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. Substack empowers independent writers, artists, videographers, podcasters, and creators of all types to create, share, and make a living off their work through subscriptions, while offering them creative freedom, ownership, and a direct connection to their audiences. About the role: We’re seeking an International Editor to tell Substack’s story across international markets on our owned channels. Together with Substack’s country leads, you will help build a bank of compelling editorial resources for our publishers, and you’ll shape and scale our brand storytelling around the world. This means crafting the strategy for how we tackle editorial needs market by market. You’ll work with translators and local agencies, all while protecting a cohesive Substack brand voice, identity, and quality bar. The ideal candidate is passionate about writing, visual storytelling, and Substack’s mission. They are committed to profiling creators and publishers across the ideological spectrum, quick to grasp complex product storytelling, and excited to help build processes and strategy from scratch. They have demonstrable experience commissioning work that has captured the zeitgeist and enriched culture, and have worked with a range of creatives across disciplines. Ideally, they have also built or expanded an editorial function at a previous organisation. This role is based in London, and reports to the Editorial Lead, with a dotted line to the Head of International. Responsibilities: Create an international storytelling strategy. Build our storytelling surfaces that hero our international creators, drive awareness to new global audiences, and enable our international partnerships team to recruit and retain publishers. Manage translators and agencies. Drive forward briefs, and oversee translators and agencies as needed to support our key international markets at scale. Collaborate across functions. Partner with Editorial, Comms, Partnerships, and country leads to make sure international editorial work is joined up with the rest of Substack’s communications and brand strategy. Protect brand voice and quality. Ensure a cohesive brand voice, identity, and quality bar across every market and every translated or localized piece of content, however many hands it passes through. Requirements: Editorial judgment. You have a keen editorial eye and can judge, quickly and confidently, what’s worth translating and localizing for an international audience. Exceptional project management. You can run multiple editorial workstreams across several markets at once, keeping translators, agencies, and internal stakeholders on schedule. A writer at heart. You are an excellent writer and communicator, with an eye for what makes a compelling narrative. Social media strategy. You have a strong eye for social media strategy and know what works on LinkedIn and how to repurpose for Instagram. Cross-functional relationship-builder. You’ll cultivate strong working relationships with Editorial, Comms, and heads of markets, and you’re comfortable prioritising competing requests from several stakeholders at once across time zones. Builder’s mindset. You’re comfortable building something (a hub, a process, a workflow) from scratch, and iterating on it as international needs evolve. Cultural fluency. You’re familiar with Substack as a creator or subscriber and excited to help champion our mission internationally. International experience. You’ve worked across international markets before, ideally in media, publishing, or communications, and understand the nuance of adapting content and brand voice for different cultural contexts. title: Graduate Tax Analyst

Fix what you find: turn those findings into a plan and take a leading role delivering it, using AI and better data so manual steps become the exception. Deliver the returns: work with our tax specialists on returns and reporting across our markets, on processes you helped improve. Why you'll want it A qualification, paid for. description: Who We Are Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France: an AI agent runs the entire sale and purchase journey end-to-end, orchestrating local brokers, portals, buyers, and documents. Les premiers outils et process tournent déjà, mais l'essentiel reste à bâtir, et c'est toi qui t'en charges. 🛠️ Ce que tu feras Ton rôle s'articule autour de quatre axes : 1. OKR : définir chaque trimestre les objectifs et les résultats clés de la squad. 2. Générer du pipe de recouvrement Run : chaque jour, revoir les ventes détectées par nos outils et décider s'il faut demander les documents officiels, comme l'acte de vente. Puis revoir les actes reçus et, à partir de l'analyse produite par nos outils, décider d'enclencher ou non le recouvrement par nos équipes. Build : automatiser chaque étape qui peut l'être, pour que le funnel opère en totale autonomie (ex : automatiser le traitement des réponses du service de publicité foncière reçues par email). Pilotage : t'assurer que le funnel tourne et qu'aucun dossier ne reste bloqué à une étape. Quand ça bloque, tu investigues, tu trouves la cause et tu la corriges. 3. Convertir le pipe avec l'équipe Sales Zefir Build : donner à l'équipe Sales des dossiers prêts à travailler : analyse juridique, brief d'appel, mises en demeure, suivi des échéanciers. Automatiser des tâches qu'ils font aujourd'hui manuellement pour augmenter leur productivité (ex : automatiser la rédaction et l'envoi des mises en demeure). Pilotage : suivre chaque semaine avec l'équipe la conversion des dossiers en protocoles signés et le cash encaissé. Repérer les indicateurs qui décrochent et proposer un plan d'action. 4. Convertir le pipe avec nos avocats Run : être l'interlocuteur de nos deux cabinets. Chaque semaine, tu tiens un point avec chacun pour revoir le pipe dossier par dossier. Build : faire évoluer l'outil de suivi partagé avec les cabinets (ex : relances automatiques, to-do priorisée, etc.). Pilotage : suivre les délais, la conversion et les coûts de chaque cabinet, et les challenger chaque semaine. Comme pour la partie Sales, tu repères les indicateurs qui décrochent et tu proposes un plan d'action. Partout, tu construis vite, en MVP, avec Claude Code, Lovable, Pipedream et BigQuery. 🙋 Profil recherché On cherche un profil Ops builder : quelqu'un qui aime partir d'une page blanche, mettre les mains dans le cambouis, puis construire les process et les automatiser. Une expérience dans un rôle Ops où tu as construit toi-même un process ou un outil de zéro, idéalement en start-up. Le goût du terrain : tu traites toi-même les premiers dossiers pour comprendre le problème avant de l'automatiser. Une vraie autonomie
